content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

- **§ 2.2 (p0013)** makes Copperleaf our "sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term" — full-term exclusive dealing with no category limit and no performance-based exit. That is the rule's walk-away position and fails the 12-month/SLA-terminable fallback.
- It also conflicts with **§ 12.3 (p0049)**, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity commitment — an internal inconsistency that should be resolved in our favour.
- Redline (validated, ok:true) replaces § 2.2 with a non-exclusive appointment expressly preserving our right to source from third parties, with the narrowed 12-month/SLA-exit version offered as fallback in the comment.
